chain_view_definition.run: the item's native mdb run, cursor at the answer row's logits (passive)
chain_view_definition.consumer: the symbols default: margin between the answer row's two largest logits (top1 - top2); no donor needed
chain_view_definition.descriptor_binding: the descriptor rows (span); lifetime = first and last layer at which the answer row's summed attention mass on the span is >= 0.1 (the symbols lifetime rule)
chain_view_definition.bridge_binding: the (row in span, layer, KV head) with the largest summed to_consumer (reads, P19) for that consumer: the symbol-table site
chain_view_definition.content_readout: the binding's write into the answer row (sum over the group's heads of p[h,r] W_o,h v[g,r]) times the final-norm gain, through the unembedding (derived-local); named bridge = best of the panel's hub tokens (single-token country names); also the full-vocabulary top 5
chain_view_definition.first_appearance: the first layer l at which the most-attended KV group's write at the bridge row names the same hub token as the bridge binding
chain_view_definition.readers: the top 3 (layer, head) reads of the span by to_consumer
chain_view_definition.readability: an item is readable when the bridge binding's named hub = the true hidden intermediate (bridge country)

baselines_frozen.B_const: the same readout at L20 KV6, last descriptor row
baselines_frozen.B_mass: the same readout at the (row, layer, KV head) with the largest summed attention mass from the answer row
baselines_frozen.B_lens: logit lens of the last descriptor row's residual at L24.h (read on the run truncated at that row), best of the hub tokens
baselines_frozen.report: readability of the view and of each baseline, per family and pooled; the view's margin over each

errors: on wrong items: view diagnosis = 'wrong bridge' if the named hub != true bridge, else 'second-hop'. Compared with the answer: wrong-capital errors (answer = capital of country X): agreement if named hub == X; non-capital errors: agreement if named hub == true bridge.
causal_check: panel recipients x different-bridge donors: V transplant of the donor's cell at the view's bridge site (stepped, Run.set_cell); after it, re-read the binding's content (donor hub named?) and the answer (donor's answer?); report the 2x2 table and the agreement rate.
forecast_and_gt: F1 (X1, sealed) vs GT from cell_sweep V over span x layers x KV heads, as in entry 1, with B_const and B_mass hit rates beside it

predictions.PR1: readability on correct items, pooled over the 10 families >= 0.80 (guess 0.88); per family >= 0.70 except para (>= 0.55)
predictions.PR2: the view beats B_lens by >= 0.20 pooled; it is within 0.05 of B_const or better pooled, and better than B_const on para and long
predictions.PR3: the view beats B_mass by >= 0.05 pooled
predictions.PR4: wrong-capital errors: named hub == the answer's country on >= 0.50; non-capital errors: named hub == true bridge on >= 0.60
predictions.PR5: causal check: content and answer move together (both to the donor or neither) on >= 0.60 of pairs; content names the donor's hub on >= 0.80
predictions.PR6: the bridge binding is L20 KV6 on >= 0.70 of correct items in every family (lang included: the read is relation-independent)
predictions.PR7: accuracy (as in prereg_ext PH1): para drops >= 0.10 vs base, dist <= 0.15, long <= 0.10, obsc <= 0.60, lang >= 0.60; F1 hit@1 >= 0.60 except para >= 0.40; F1 - B_const >= 0 pooled
